title: Bound coded R429 owner costs and alternating row sections
body:
## Summary

Bind the coded R429 caller's local saving to its complete fixed owner allocation. Returning deleted helper capacity reduces the saving to 60 per call; the known two-N terminal bill leaves an 864-unit deficit. A separate row-section theorem explains why the nine-stage alternating caller cannot close its coded endpoint with three repaired rows per stage.

The package adds a uniform comparison for all nonnegative exponents, the strict 860-unit terminal allowance, and an exact classification of the 2,270 feasible three-row sections. See `research/r429-controller-accounting/PROOF.md` and `EVIDENCE-INDEX.md`.

## Scope and limits

This is one fixed coded-controller accounting and endpoint boundary. The local 651-column VALUE identity is inherited from #3645. New checks cover every retained owner, the literal frame/COPY invoice and all changed pending ADDRESS operators. The 888 terminal and 444 gather counts price named constructions; neither is a universal lower bound. The section census uses its stated root-line/two-tier alphabet. No physical supplier, precision admission, selected-record change or new kappa is claimed.

## Test plan

- [x] CPython 3.12 committed-byte/source-history preflight and all six registered commands.
- [x] Read-only Git-free export replay, with unchanged package bytes.
- [x] Separate AI reviews of owner accounting, section algebra/census and source/control integrity; findings resolved in the package.
- [x] Automatic [registered-package CI](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39416402875) passed on `86aa870336c05404855befe51bc0a5155cbc2252` (plan and package replay).

The scientific checks include 123,552 owner roles, 71,040 deadlines, 326,784 pending ADDRESS columns, all 70,626 admissible sections and 120 root lines, plus normal/optimized Python controls. Full receipts are compared with scalar types and event ordering preserved. AI reviews are distinct from human acceptance or formal proof.

## Sources and credit

Retains Ali Romman/#1043, Sagar Thakrar/#2423, commdata2338/#2653 and #1307 geometry ancestry; #3645 supplies the local source-coded word. James Reed/#3672 independently recorded its local arithmetic. Exact inputs, prior notices, heads and adaptations are recorded in `SOURCES.json`, `ORIGINS.json`, `RELATED-WORK.json` and the frozen manifest. Original findings, further derivations and this package were prepared by Ross Richardson with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Apache-2.0.
